cards.words_note: Visible typed words match TOAST (photos 1, 11) and the 9/28/12 YESTERDAY'S SONGS / countdown sheet (photo 2). The '8/4/2013' typed after TOAST is really the date on the HERO'S SAGA sheet underneath. Typed text is cut at 'Four da', so the other ~12 poems in the bundle (HUNCH, DRINK MORE WATER, UNDEFINED, WORTH A SHOT, POINT OF REFERENCE, HERO'S SAGA, HARD TO HEAR, CHEMISTRY, WILL DO, OH YOU KNOW, HARD WORK, LIVING IN A JIMMY BUFFET SONG) could not be checked here.
cards.name_note: TOAST is the title of the top sheet sitting under the 1764 blocks. The piece is a bundle of about 14 typed poems.
cards.other_problems: Photo 24 is a guitar with blocks 1765 - it belongs on item 1765, take it off this card. Photos 12-23 (12 photos) show a different set of pieces (the 'CHECK ALL These' table: First Draft Finished Songs binder, Exit the Sandman, Candy Rapper Superstar noted 1598, Big Binder noted 1599, Song Index, The Paradigm, With You, Gilligan Smiles, Amongst Men) - no 1764 blocks and none of their words are typed here; they look like other catalogue numbers' photos. Photo 8 shows cut-off blocks '2' and '9' from a neighbouring piece. Turned copies for photos 12 and 24 are still sideways; photo 20 (as the website shows it) is sideways.
